# Papilio

> A cozy, aesthetic, premium patisserie-café in Excise Colony, Hanamkonda, Warangal. Established October 2023. Rated 4.3★ by 1,300+ diners.

Papilio is a patisserie-led café in Hanamkonda, Warangal serving artisan celebration cakes, French-inspired counter desserts, specialty coffee, sourdough pizza, pasta, burgers, and continental fare.

## Key Information
- **Location:** H.No. 2-7-741, Excise Colony, Hanamkonda, Warangal, Telangana 506370, India
- **Coordinates:** 17.9962° N, 79.5379° E
- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 10:30 PM (Open all seven days)
- **Phone:** +91 90003 16366
- **WhatsApp:** +91 90003 16366
- **FSSAI License:** No. 23626018000482
- **Ratings:** 4.3★ on Swiggy (1,300+ ratings), 4.3★ on Zomato, 4.1★ on Google
